title: Issue with Open5gs 2.7.1 Version for Attach for Second attempt
body:
Hi, With open5gs 2.7.1, we are able to attach for the first attempt after reboot. But for the second attempt, we are not able to get attach. Only if i restart nrf and amf services, i am able to attach again. 

Plz find the logs below for the attach for the first time and also for second attempt when it was  not attaching. It would be great if some insight is given.
